title: Travelling Dark State Polariton as a Viable Quantum Memory in a Solid-State Medium
summary: We theorize a quantum memory based on the dark-state polariton field, formed by the superposition of atomic and photonic states of a travelling probe laser pulse under the application of standing wave modes of a dominant control laser pulse using a lambda-level scheme Electromagnetically Induced Transparency in a solid medium. We show how an enhancement in the storage time for the pulse is achieved by eliminating pulse broadening due to diffusion.
